page_title: CLE 0-1 LYO | Clermont v Lyon 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Habib Keita (Clermont) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+2' Having seen unsporting behavior, Pierre Gaillouste shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is the recipient.
90+1' Clermont can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pierre Gaillouste had an easy-decision to make.
87' Ilhan Fakili (Clermont) drills a shot towards goal after the ball is whipped into the penalty area, but it goes miles wide of the left post.
84' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ilhan Fakili (Clermont) replacing Alan Virginius.
84' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Muhammed Cham will be replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
82' Clermont have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nemanja Matic leaves the pitch and Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) comes on.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Clermont.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is replacing Henrique.
75' Here is a change. Rayan Cherki is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon).
73' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Jim Allevinah (Clermont) replaces Elbasan Rashani.
73' It is time for a substitution. Habib Keita (Clermont) is on for Johan Gastien.
71' Clermont fail to score from a corner as Anthony Lopes (Lyon) leaps to collect the ball.

70' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Anthony Lopes is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Clermont will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
68' Neto Borges (Clermont) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
67' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gift Orban.
66' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
64' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

63' He should have scored! Neto Borges (Clermont) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Anthony Lopes makes an easy save. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gift Orban (Lyon) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Clermont as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
60' There's a break in play and referee Pierre Gaillouste must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Clermont using VAR. This could be interesting!
59' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
59' Rough tackle by Maxence Caqueret (Lyon). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Orel Mangala (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul.
53' 0 - 1 Goal! Rayan Cherki provides Orel Mangala (Lyon) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
53' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
53' Clinton Mata (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
51' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
48' The game is interrupted. Andy Pelmard (Clermont) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Anthony Lopes makes a comfortable save.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Clermont, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Neto Borges (Clermont) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
44' The players claim that Clinton Mata (Lyon) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Clermont get a free kick.
42' Neto Borges (Clermont) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
40' The ratio of the ball possession is 47:53.
37' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
33' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
32' Half-chance! Neto Borges (Clermont) plays a pass into the box, but Anthony Lopes reacts well to snuff out the attack.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul after Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Henrique (Lyon) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
27' The opposition give Clinton Mata (Lyon) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
26' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Elbasan Rashani (Clermont).
24' Clinton Mata (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Pierre Gaillouste saw the whole situation.
23' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Clermont comes to nothing.
21' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall. Now Clermont have a corner.
20' Dangerous play by Malick Fofana (Lyon). Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul. Clermont have a free kick from a promising distance.
19' Neto Borges (Clermont) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Anthony Lopes, who smothers the ball.
17' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

14' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

14' Alan Virginius (Clermont) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Anthony Lopes thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
13' A cross into the box from Malick Fofana (Lyon) is cleared.
10' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
8' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Malick Fofana (Lyon) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.

6' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the right post and ricochets away.
5' Clermont are ruled offside.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Clermont, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Anthony Lopes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
